### 🥇 Google (Pixel)
**Pick this if:** You want the best camera experience, the cleanest Android software, and cutting-edge AI features.

- **The Good:** Google's Pixel phones are known for their "point and shoot" camera magic—the software processing makes photos look fantastic with minimal effort. - **Weaknesses:** Complex pricing, steep learning curve, console can be overwhelming
- **Choose AWS if:** You need the widest range of services, are building at massive scale, or your team already has deep AWS expertise

**Best for:** Microsoft-centric organizations, hybrid cloud, enterprise environments

- **Weaknesses:** Some services lag AWS in maturity; documentation can be inconsistent
- **Choose Azure if:** Your organization is invested in the Microsoft ecosystem, needs strong hybrid cloud support, or wants tight integration with enterprise tools

**Best for:** Data analytics, AI/ML, Kubernetes-native workloads, open-source-friendly teams
- **Strengths:** Best-in-class data & analytics (BigQuery), leading AI/ML offerings, invented Kubernetes (GKE is excellent), strong network infrastructure, clean UI
